description: This file defines a custom ArrayAdapter named StableArrayAdapter for an Android application. It manages a list of strings with stable IDs and attaches a touch listener to each view for handling swipe gestures.

classes.name: StableArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter for displaying a list of strings with stable IDs and touch event handling.

methods.name: StableArrayAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter with context, resource ID, list of strings, and a touch listener. It maps each string to its index.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns a stable ID for the item at the specified position based on the string-to-index mapping.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that this adapter has stable IDs for items.

methods.name: getView
methods.description: Returns the view for the item at the specified position, attaching a touch listener to detect swipe motions.
